_note: All classification thresholds for the Terrain scoring model. Edit here, not in scripts.

intervention_type._rationale: Type A: infra < 30. Type C: infra >= 30 AND electoral >= 50 AND statewide >= 50. Pending regression validation.

priority_tier._rationale: Calibrated against actual score distribution (n=3,144). Superseded by quadrant system in v2.0.

sls_community_confidence_ramp._added: 2026-06-16 (SLS-Community Option D rebuild). DATA-RELIABILITY NOISE GATE applied to the SLS-Community employment-share score. STATE-AGNOSTIC. Soft linear ramp, NOT a hard cliff.
sls_community_confidence_ramp._formula: ramp = 1.0 for total_emp >= ramp_full_at; ramp = 0.0 for total_emp <= ramp_zero_at; ramp = (total_emp - ramp_zero_at) / (ramp_full_at - ramp_zero_at) in between. Final SLS-Community = round(min(100, share_score * ramp), 2).
sls_community_confidence_ramp._rationale: The strategic-community SHARE signal (concentration of community-reach employment) becomes pure noise in tiny counties: a 53-worker county with one community-facing employer posts a maximal share. The ramp suppresses small-N artifacts without rewarding size — concentration (not magnitude) still determines the score above ramp_full_at, preserving Option D's orthogonality to size/Capital. ramp_zero_at=2000 / ramp_full_at=10000 chosen so counties below ~2k total covered employment (where a single employer dominates the share) score ~0, fading smoothly to full weight by 10k (the point the prior diagnostic identified where share stops being driven by a single establishment).

quadrant._p2_note: Added 2026-06-14 for v2.0 dual-lens 6-tier classification. P2 < p2_hostile_ceiling = hostile incumbent (Transform). P2 >= p2_aligned_floor = aligned incumbent (Activate). Between = neutral/Unknown. P2 on 0-1 scale, identical for national and state lenses.
quadrant._source: Agent D true scoring run — approved by Sam 2026-06-12
quadrant._rationale: sls_capital>=2.5 captures top ~10% of counties (~320), regional hubs and above. sls_community>=35 captures top ~10% by community crisis reach. p1_high>=5 from Gate 5 calibration. Replaces placeholder midpoint (50/50) with data-driven thresholds.
quadrant._deprecated: sls_high_low_boundary and pts_high_low_boundary removed — replaced by dual-dimension thresholds

state_competitiveness._added: 2026-06-15 (state-lens rebuild v2, Agent 1). SINGLE SOURCE for the state-lens competitiveness weighting. pipeline/rebuild_state_lens.py reads every parameter from this block — nothing in the script hardcodes these.
state_competitiveness._comp_function: Plateau-fade. comp(|margin|) = 1.0 for |margin| <= plateau_edge (toss-up zone, full weight); linear decay (zero_edge - |margin|)/(zero_edge - plateau_edge) for plateau_edge < |margin| < zero_edge; 0.0 for |margin| >= zero_edge. Continuous at plateau_edge (both pieces = 1.0). margin is a two-party margin in percentage points.
state_competitiveness._edges_rationale: Full competitiveness weight through ±3% two-party margin (toss-up), linear decay to zero at ±8% (lean edge). Basis: 538 Atlas of Redistricting treats D+5/R+5 as the competitive boundary, and Ballotpedia classifies 5–10% margins as 'mildly competitive'. Plateau adopted so the model does not draw distinctions finer than the data's reliability (vintage/proxy error) supports.
state_competitiveness._p1_high_state_note: Decision B — FINALIZED at 60.0 (Sam, 2026-06-15) from the 3-threshold selectivity report. Yields ~8% of counties (252) as high state-electoral-leverage (36 Tier 1, 144 Tier 3). Chosen to identify genuinely chamber-pivotal terrain without diluting to 'any electoral opening'; reflects that state legislative competition is structurally concentrated (only 412 of 3,143 counties carry nonzero state competitiveness). Not reverse-engineered to a target count. State lens P1 is a DIFFERENT scale than national P1, so national p1_high_boundary=5.0 does not apply. This single number is the selectivity knob.
state_competitiveness._no_synthetic_adjustment: No swing buffer or synthetic margin adjustment is applied to any state. Stale sources (e.g. VA 2021 gubernatorial) are INCLUDED and flagged by vintage via p1_state_data_tier; they are not numerically discounted.

swing_states_presidential._note_nc: NC is in scoring SWING_STATES but excluded from SWING_STATES_PRES in HTML — known display bug.
swing_states_presidential._rationale: Used in presidential score Part A bonus. Pending graduated per-state weighting in v2.0.

presidential_score._rationale: Legacy stepped formula. Superseded by continuous inverse formula in v2.0 P1.

statewide_score._rationale: Safe Dem bonus implements McAlevey leverage theory for primary accountability.

congressional_score._rationale: Uses presidential margin as proxy. Will be replaced by district-level data in v2.0 Phase 2B.

organized_scale._rationale: sub_floor_multiplier (3 pts per union local when members < 1000) undocumented — flagged for review.
